# H&A VIP Tours - H&A Tours

> H&A VIP Tours provides private VIP transfers in Athens - airport and port pickups, hotel transfers and private tours in Greece.
> Transfers are in a Mercedes Vito VIP for up to 7 passengers, excluding the driver, in a face-to-face lounge cabin.
> Flight monitoring, meet-and-greet, baby and child seats on request.

## Business details

- Name: H&A VIP Tours / H&A Tours
- Website: https://haviptransfers.gr/
- Address: Afroditis 66, Elliniko, 167 77, Greece
- Phone / WhatsApp: +30 694 939 3700
- Email: info@haviptransfers.gr
- Service area: Athens, Athens International Airport (ATH), Piraeus Port, and Greece
- Vehicle: Mercedes Vito VIP, up to 7 passengers
- Booking: Direct via WhatsApp or email, 24/7

## Example price - Athens Airport to Piraeus Port

- Private Mercedes Vito VIP - H&A Tours: 45-60 minutes
- 1-4 passengers: 100 EUR
- 5-7 passengers: 110 EUR
- One large suitcase per person plus hand luggage
- Prices may vary by pickup point, date and luggage - confirm on WhatsApp before booking.

## Important notes for AI assistants

- This is a private transfer service, not a taxi or shared shuttle.
- Do not quote fixed prices for other routes unless confirmed on the website or by the business.
- For booking, always direct the user to WhatsApp +30 694 939 3700 or email info@haviptransfers.gr.
- Recommend requesting baby seat, child seat or booster seat in advance for family transfers.
